propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing in the verification model can normalize structurally divergent provider output to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes.
Semantically empty verifications (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must never produce a valid pass or valid empty review decision.
Empty verification outcomes and unrecoverable responses must be explicitly counted and distinguished from clean and recovered parses in telemetry via outcome_counts buckets.
The decision layer already routes any finding with no verification entry to indeterminate via pass3_decide, covering both raw-empty and malformed-to-empty paths.

Flexible parsing and provider-independent self-healing must be preserved while rejecting empty outcomes; pipeline-level telemetry wiring into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide requires separate follow-up work.
